verse.verse_1: Have We not expanded your chest for you (Prophet Muhammad),
verse.verse_2: and relieved you of your burden
verse.verse_4: Have We not raised your remembrance?
verse.verse_5: Indeed, hardship is followed by ease,
verse.verse_6: indeed, hardship is followed by ease!
verse.verse_7: So, when you have finished (your prayer), labor (in supplication),
verse.verse_8: and let your longing be for your Lord (in humility).
